title: Rankings | AI Product Traffic Surges Globally — ChatGPT Independent Visitors Top 200M
summary: From chatbots to smart search, graphic design, and writing tools, AI products are embedding into daily work and life. Unique Research’s February read of the 2024 Global AIGC Industry Monthly shows:
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Ranking snapshot · March 16, 2024

From chatbots to smart search, graphic design, and writing tools, AI products are embedding into daily work and life. Unique Research’s February read of the 2024 Global AIGC Industry Monthly shows:

  • Scale AI products worldwide (monthly visits >10k): 1,854 (−4.23% MoM) — still a large market
  • Global AIGC product visits in February: 6.886B (+15.30% vs January’s 5.972B)
  • Total visit duration: 863M hours vs January’s 788M (+9.52%) — users spending more time
  • ChatGPT unique visitors: 201M — about 2.51% of world population

Category heat in February concentrated in chatbots, smart search, graphic design, and writing software. ChatGPT and Bing led visits (dialogue + search-integrated AI demand); Canva underscored design-tool reach. New board entrants such as Google’s Gemini show how fast competition and innovation are moving.

Bottom line from the February monthly: tech progress and user demand are still climbing; competition should keep pushing function, UX, and product innovation. Full boards and methodology live in the companion traffic monthly package.

4 CN images; attach on ingest.

— END —
